projects.name: Blucast
projects.pitch: NVIDIA Broadcast, but for Linux: real-time AI background removal, replacement and blur on a virtual camera, built on the Maxine SDK.

projects.name: AudioBolt
projects.pitch: Finds where a phone recording was made from the planes you can barely hear in it: Doppler curves, ADS-B tracks and mains hum, run by an AI agent.

projects.name: WattSentry
projects.pitch: Forecasting and control for rooftop solar, home batteries, wind farms and the low-voltage grid, on one map of Romania, every 15 minutes.

projects.name: WindMon
projects.pitch: Wind farm monitoring: live S3 ingestion, anomaly detection, TSO-ready daily reports and LLM fleet briefings. Built in 24h, hardened after.
